headline: Colombia's CRC Prepares 18 Regulatory Changes for Telecom Services
summary: Colombia's Communications Regulation Commission published its proposed regulatory agenda for the next two years, outlining various updates for telecom services.
why: Regulatory frameworks set by national telecommunications commissions directly affect operational compliance and market conditions for telecom providers.

impacts.name: Telecommunications
impacts.why: New regulatory proposals from the CRC will govern operations and services for telecom companies in Colombia.
